name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys grew up around engines; his father owned a small garage in rural New Zealand. From a young age, he was tinkering with anything that had moving parts. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering before landing a job at a local racing team, building his skills in precision machining and problem-solving under pressure. His dedication and adaptable nature quickly made him an invaluable asset.

After several successful seasons, an opportunity with McLaren Racing arose, and Rhys jumped at the chance to work at the pinnacle of motorsport. He thrives on the challenge of creating and maintaining the high-performance components of a Formula 1 car, embracing new technologies and constantly seeking ways to improve efficiency and reliability. Rhys prides himself on his meticulous approach and his ability to find practical solutions to complex problems, often working independently to deliver exceptional results.

Rhys is known for his calm demeanor and unwavering focus, even in the most stressful situations. He is a reliable and dedicated member of the team, always willing to go the extra mile to ensure the car performs at its best. His loyalty and independent spirit make him a unique and respected figure within the McLaren garage.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of whistling softly while working, usually 80's rock anthems.
Insists on using Imperial measurements alongside metric, much to the amusement of his colleagues.
